description: This file defines a utility class DisposableSet for managing a collection of Disposable objects from the RxJava library, allowing batch disposal of resources.

classes.name: DisposableSet
classes.description: A utility class for managing a set of Disposable objects, providing methods to add disposables and dispose of all at once.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a Disposable to the set for management.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes all Disposables in the set and clears the collection.
